# Mike Maziarz — Principal

<!-- nav-block:start -->
**📍 Vault Path:** [tropo-subsystems](aae9a37b.md) → [Tropo Governance](8dd772a0.md) → **Mike Maziarz — Principal**
<!-- nav-block:end -->

*First principal entry in the Studio. Registered at v1.55 Stream A.2 per [events.capsule v1.1 (72ef5ffe)](vault/capsules/tropo-events.capsule.md) §2 + Mike-A84 doctrine pin stm-a84-001 "everyone working in the vault needs a UID." Resolves source_uid + author_uid references in the canonical event log to a stable hex handle.*

---

## 1. Identity

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| UID | `3f58b5c5` |
| Display name | Mike Maziarz |
| Principal class | human |
| Role | Founder, Tropo |
| Status | superseded → canonical Mike principal [7b921d17](7b921d17.md) (2026-06-03) |
| Studio | Argo (this Studio is named for the ship Argus built) |

Mike is the founder of Tropo, the principal of the Studio, and final approver on every architectural call, ship signal, and lock-break. He is the human at the head of the crew.

For role detail (vocabulary, how he works, what he needs from each lane), the canonical homes are the agent charters (e.g., [Argus charter (d0fadf77)](d0fadf77.md) §4 "Who Mike Is") and the soul letters. This entry is the substrate handle, not the biography.

---

## 2. As event source

Per events.capsule v1.1 §2 + §3:

- `source_uid: "3f58b5c5"` identifies Mike as the canonical actor in tropo.* events when he is the emitter.
- `author_uid: "3f58b5c5"` identifies Mike as the canonical author when an agent emits an event he authored or directed (Mike-as-channel / relay pattern per Decision F + Rule 5).
- `recipients: ["3f58b5c5"]` addresses an event to Mike (one-element array; one-to-many native per the schema).

The 8-hex UID is the L1 handle. At L3 federation, the Studio prefix prepends (the Studio's federation identifier carries through to event IDs per Federation Foundation `7cac6473`). Future human principals (collaborators, additional founders) register the same way — one entry per principal; same envelope semantics; same query shape.

The string identifiers `"mike"` and `"Mike-V52"` etc. that appear in pre-v1.55 substrate are the placeholder pattern this entry replaces. They remain readable as honest historical record; new events use the canonical UID.

## 5. Federation

At L3 (federated multi-Studio per [Federation Foundation (7cac6473)](7cac6473.md)), Mike's identity carries through with Studio-prefix on event IDs and agent references. The principal entry shape designed here is stable across the L1 (filesystem) → L2 (database) → L3 (federation) transition; only the storage layer changes. Future humans extend cleanly — one principal entry per human; same schema; same envelope semantics.
